options.name: --age
options.description: Number of months after which a branch is considered stale  (default: 6).

options.name: --all
options.description: Select every candidate branch without showing the  multi-select prompt.

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Preview the branches that would be deleted without  deleting anything.

options.name: --fetch
options.description: Run 'git fetch --prune' before scanning so  branches whose upstream was deleted on the remote are detected as gone.

options.name: --gone-only
options.description: Only include safe gone branches: upstream gone and really  merged into the target.

options.name: --merged-only
options.description: Only include branches already merged into the target  branch.

options.name: --path
options.description: Path to the git repository to clean (defaults to current  directory).

options.name: --stale-only
options.description: Only include stale branches older than the configured  age.

options.name: --yes
options.description: Skip the final confirmation prompt. Intended for  automation with --all.
